Streaming chat completion with tool/function call chunks

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What's the weather?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"city\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chatStream(req)
    println(result)
}
```
